projectDescription: A web tool that takes any Atlas documentation URL and converts the entire documentation site into a downloadable PDF.
keyFeatures: Convert any Atlas documentation site to PDF via URL
Full-site crawl — captures every page in the documentation
Fast, no-install web tool — works in the browser
publicApiSurface: URL input field — accepts any Atlas documentation URL
PDF download — generated file delivered to the browser
Page selection — choose all pages or a custom subset
Export options — configure PDF layout and formatting
